predictions.articleTitle: France vs Türkiye Prediction & Match Analysis: Can a Reshuffled Defense Hold? — xG & Scoreline Preview
predictions.coreRecommendation: France are projected to secure a home victory in Bordeaux over Over 2.5 total goals as Kylian Mbappé's return targets a suspension-hit Türkiye backline.
possibilityAssessment: Primary Thesis (Core): Home Win driven by France's attacking return and Türkiye's 2.60 goals conceded per game (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)
Secondary Angle (Value): Over 2.5 Goals backed by 2.90 baseline lambda and depleted defensive personnel on both sides (Confidence: Moderate, Value: High)
Contingency Angle (Hedge / Upset): Türkiye to breach France's improvised Konaté-Jacquet center-back pairing via Arda Güler (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)

bet_recommendations.match_highlight: Mbappé returns to test a Kabak-less Türkiye defense while France reshuffle.

spf.comment: Anchored on 2:1 and 3:1 scripts where France's returning attack outscores a winless, Kabak-less Türkiye side despite French defensive absentees.
